name: soul_bolt_impact
for: wraith_lord soul bolt: hit (hero or shield)
notes: The soul breaks on the hit: the skull shows for one frame, a cold white flash, then its ectoplasm splashes forward and up in eight wavering strands that drift upward and wear away, bone-white shards fall, a thin blue mist rises and cold motes blink out. Anchor = hit point. 10 frames @12 fps. Also fine for the low bolt hit.
